CREATE TABLE `competency_regression_alerts` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`employee_id` int NOT NULL,
	`snapshot_id` int NOT NULL,
	`previous_snapshot_id` int NOT NULL,
	`competency_id` int NOT NULL,
	`previous_level` int NOT NULL,
	`current_level` int NOT NULL,
	`level_drop` int NOT NULL,
	`alert_date` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`notification_sent` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	`resolved_at` timestamp,
	`notes` text,
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `competency_regression_alerts_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
